## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and what changes. Link a real issue if applicable.

## Verification

List commands actually run and results. Note baseline failures and checks not run.
For docs-only changes, verify links, rendering, commands and factual status claims.

## Review and limits

- Does this affect permissions, identity, credentials, provider data, storage or external actions?
- What remains unavailable or pending independent review?
- For phase work, attach the required structured review evidence; a merge alone is not approval.

Confirm the diff contains no secrets, owner audio/embeddings, private documents or runtime data.
